name: Nei Restina
source:
An older sister of twin sisters who is practicing at a church in Solide.
She was entrusted with the guidance of the priest by the priest with her sister and welcomed her in Solide.
Witness the moment when the hero summons the devil, and tells the priest that it was "the figure of the devil that was in the teaching".
It's easy to believe rumors and lies, and it often makes a fuss and makes people wonder.
